QUOTE: "Restart the MCP client. A rebuild cannot clear it, since it re-stamps the same newer version." and "`code` | Process loaded old logic | Restart the MCP client. A rebuild cannot fix it." alongside "`data` | Sources changed since build | `index(action='refresh')`"
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that data is cleared by a refresh/rebuild while code needs a client restart that a rebuild cannot fix, which is the item's different-actions-per-axis substance. The "why one flag wasn't enough" is implicit in the three-axis design, and I judged the item satisfied.
